# Bundled files for auto.html

`auto.html` (the standalone sheet generator) loads everything from here, so it works with no internet connection.

| File | What | Version | License |
|---|---|---|---|
| `xlsx.full.min.js` | SheetJS Community Edition: reads and writes .xlsx | 0.18.5 | Apache-2.0 |
| `gsap.min.js` | GSAP: the page's animations | 3.12.5 | GreenSock "Standard no charge" license, https://gsap.com/standard-license |
| `fonts/*.woff2`, `fonts.css` | Space Grotesk, IBM Plex Sans, IBM Plex Mono (Latin subset) | via @fontsource | SIL Open Font License 1.1 |

Update by installing the npm packages (`xlsx@0.18.5`, `gsap`, `@fontsource/*`) and copying the same files.
